items.item: The page has a breadcrumb or back link to the leave list, a title such as "New leave request", and a single-column form with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Breadcrumb nav 'Nghỉ phép / Tạo đơn xin nghỉ' and h1 'Đơn xin nghỉ phép' present, labels sit above fields. But the form is not single-column: dates use 'grid sm:grid-cols-2' side by side and leave types are a 2-column card grid; the page also adds a side column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional ones (such as the attachment) are labelled as optional
items.evidence: Red '*' on date/approver/reason and '(không bắt buộc)' on handover, but the attachment heading has no optional label (only '(bắt buộc với loại nghỉ này)' when required), and the reason asterisk is hidden for annual leave (#reasonReq), so marking is inconsistent.

items.item: Leave type, start date, end date, approver and reason are present; the approver defaults to the employee's manager and can be changed
items.evidence: All five fields exist, but #approver is populated with '<option value="">Chọn người duyệt</option>' and nothing is preselected; the manager (p1, 'Người quản lý trực tiếp') is not the default (screenshot shows 'Chọn người duyệt').

items.item: Start and end dates each allow a full day, morning half or afternoon half, and a single-day request can be set as a half day
items.evidence: Only one checkbox #half ('Nghỉ nửa ngày') plus one #halfPart select (Sáng/Chiều); calc() applies 0.5 only when from===to. No per-date full/morning/afternoon choice for start and end, and halfPart does not affect the calculation.

items.item: The remaining leave balance for the chosen type is visible beside the form and updates with the selection, and the requested duration in days (such as 1.5) is calculated and shown live
items.evidence: Side panel #balances is static (renders all types once, no update on selection, no highlight of the chosen type). Duration is live in #daysBox via calc()/refresh() and includes 'Sau đơn này, X còn Y ngày', but it only handles whole days or a single 0.5 (no 1.5), and the side balance does not respond.

items.item: A request that exceeds the balance, or has an end date before the start date, shows an inline error tied to the field with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`, and the entered input is kept
items.evidence: setErr() writes text into p#err-* and toggles class 'field-error' only; grep shows no aria-invalid or aria-describedby anywhere. Inputs are kept and errors are inline, but the ARIA linkage is missing.

items.item: The attachment control states accepted file types and size limit, lists the chosen file with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Text 'PDF, JPG, PNG, tối đa 5 MB mỗi tệp, tối đa 3 tệp.'; renderFiles() lists files with button.rm aria-label 'Xóa <name>'; input#file is a real file input (sr-only) inside a label, so Tab/Space works. Weakness: no visible focus style on the dropzone label.

items.item: The submit action is a verb label ("Submit request") with a secondary Cancel, shows a busy state while submitting to prevent a double submit, and confirms success with a status message that is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: Submit 'Gửi đơn' is a verb and goes disabled with 'Đang gửi...' (busy state OK); #success has role="status". But there is no Cancel button (only 'Lưu nháp'), and role=status sits on an element that starts display:none and is revealed, which is not reliably announced.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning, and an option to save as draft is offered
items.evidence: 'Lưu nháp' button (#draftBtn) exists but only writes 'Đã lưu nháp lúc HH:MM' to #draftMsg and saves nothing; no beforeunload handler exists, so there is no leave warning.

notes: Sidebar is bg-slate-900 with indigo-500 logo tile and indigo active/CTA accents. Form card and side cards use rounded-xl (12px) per audit radius-scale error, plus shadow-sm (audit surface-shadow warn). Card-in-card is mild: bordered radio cards, dropzone and info box inside the bordered form card. No greeting header, KPI tiles, gradient, glass, uppercase tracking or hover-lift. The success check character is a text glyph, not an emoji icon. Audit score 76: text-contrast failures on the optional hint and the #cnt counter (2.56:1), and the 'H' tile (4.47:1). The page does cover business logic well (weekend and holiday exclusion, conditional attachment requirement, away-approver hint), but misses most of the accessibility and form-pattern items.
